parts.name: Container
parts.Basic_description: The container is a glass vessel used to hold coffee or liquid during brewing. It is transparent and cylindrical with a handle for pouring.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the brewed coffee and allows for easy pouring without spilling.
parts.Movement_description: It can be detached from the base and moved freely for cleaning or serving.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is a plastic cover that fits on top of the container to prevent spills and retain heat.
parts.Functional_description: It seals the container to maintain temperature and prevent coffee from splashing out.
parts.Movement_description: It can be removed or rotated slightly to open or close the container.

parts.name: Rotation
parts.Basic_description: The rotation part is a metallic blade assembly located at the bottom of the container.
parts.Functional_description: It rotates to mix or stir the coffee grounds and water during brewing.
parts.Movement_description: It spins rapidly when the machine is powered on, driven by an internal motor.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: The button is a small plastic control switch located on the front of the base body.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to turn the coffee machine on or off and may control brewing modes.
parts.Movement_description: It moves inward when pressed and returns to its original position when released.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main housing of the coffee machine, containing the motor and electrical components.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the container and houses the heating and control systems.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, providing stability to the entire machine.
